text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy, 
I heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-Tachyon-san, you shouldn't just live on 
field rations... You really ought to eat 
proper meals too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Considering all possible variables, this 
is by far the most efficient and practical 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what perfect timing. You over 
there agree with me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait! I... made a boxed lunch for 
you!

When Nishino Flower opened her bento box, 
it was packed full of colorful side 
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, now this is……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, now this is……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Carrots cut into hearts and stars, 
and sausages shaped like little 
octopuses?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot comprehend its shape whatsoever, 
and yet... it is utterly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I thought the octopus sausages looked 
so tasty, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. You were investigating the 
shift in taste perception triggered by 
visual effects!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, my interest is piqued even 
further. If it serves beneficial research, 
I shall lend my aid!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I would be so happy if you'd eat 
it...♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That seems to contain a slight excess of 
beta-carotene. Does it not surpass the 
recommended daily intake?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I boiled a whole carrot! Apparently 
it doesn't lose its nutrients that way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Also, hoping it would suit your tastes, 
Tachyon-san, I stewed it nice and sweet, 
ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a very rational method of cooking. 
The approach to my palate is flawless and 
leaves nothing to be desired.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. It appears to possess distinct 
advantages compared to standard rations. 
This is well worth considering!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, um... I'd be so happy if you ate it, 
even if it's just to 'consider' it...!
